provider_scope: Same exact checkpoints as cycle 02; no cloud or variant substitution.
quality_gate: Unchanged from cycle 02: per checkpoint, paired elimination wins cannot decrease, losses/caps and own deaths cannot increase, and total ticks on common elimination wins cannot increase. Require strict quality improvement. One fresh holdout map is limited evidence, never global optimality.
iteration_stop: Reject candidate on any gate regression; do not tune after holdout. No automatic default promotion and no extra calls after budget exhaustion.
hypothesis: The previous anti-cycle candidate sometimes sacrifices an ally. Before ranking, keep friendly-lane-safe roots with the highest minimum predicted own survivor count across the same opponent policies. Keep other coefficients and model readout unchanged.
safety: Old cycle02 holdout is now explicitly development data. No user-match interruption, retries, warmups, cloud calls or weight changes.
